summary:
Comprehensive architectural blueprint and implementation plan for:
1. Moving the Polyglot Kernel and Smart Component Authoring Studio to a dedicated /kernel page with 3 dedicated sub-tabs (Polyglot Kernel, Smart Component Authoring, and Real-Time Agent Interaction).
2. Implementing real C# backend execution with automatic public property reflection, custom attribute inspection ([Tool], [Description]), and editor IntelliSense.
3. Node compatibility in Authoring Studio supporting categories: state machine, shelltools, modules, mcpserver, and agent-as-mcp with visual authoring.
4. Workflow canvas integration enabling double-click node configuration for smart components with live property binding and n8n-style inline expressions.
5. Real-time Agent interaction tab adhering to the Microsoft Agent Framework Provider Support Matrix and AG-UI state management protocol.
